title: Steven and Maureen Klinsky Visiting Professor of Practice for Leadership and Progress
bio: Susan M. Davies is the Steven and Maureen Klinsky Visiting Professor of Practice for Leadership and Progress at Harvard Law School. Davies served as Deputy White House Counsel to President Barack Obama, where she managed the Supreme Court confirmations for Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Elena Kagan.
